blocks.content: Local time is determined by the position of the Sun at a particular longitude. Places east experience sunrise earlier than places west.
Local time is determined by the position of the Sun at a particular longitude.

items: Remember that local time varies continuously with changes in longitude.
Exam questions frequently test the concept that places in the East gain time relative to places in the West.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Local time is directly determined by the position of the Sun at a specific longitude.
Geographical regions located further east experience sunrise earlier than regions to the west.
